svg.title: Scale AI Framework: From Pilot to Enterprise
svg.desc: Four phases in sequence, following Microsoft Learn's Scale AI in your organization module. Phase 1, unlock AI value: align leaders on two or three strategic bets, prove ROI with focused pilots, secure executive sponsorship and define KPIs. Phase 2, organise for AI success: AI Council plus Centre of Excellence plus business unit leads, with clear roles to decide, build and govern. Phase 3, empower business users: broad Copilot rollout with AI in everyday apps, backed by a champions programme and training. Phase 4, empower subject matter experts: experts build their own agents and apps with no-code and low-code tools such as Copilot Studio, Power Platform and Microsoft Foundry, with the CoE mentoring and reviewing.
svg.text: Scale AI Framework: From Pilot to Enterprise
Prove value, organise for it, then put AI in the hands of users and experts.
Broad Copilot rollout: AI in everyday apps
Experts build their own agents and apps
No/low-code: Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Foundry
